goal: Write a pet surgery aftercare sheet as a Word document: what to expect the first 24 hours, feeding, keeping the stitches clean, the cone, medicine schedule as a table (medicine, dose, times a day, days), warning signs that mean call us now, and the clinic phone line placeholder. Save it as {dir}\surgery-aftercare.docx

Make an Excel daily sales tracker for a taco truck: columns for date, location, tacos sold, burritos sold, drinks sold, prices in a small price table at the top, revenue per row as a formula from the price table, a running total, and a totals row with SUM formulas. Fill in 10 sample days. Save it as {dir}\truck-sales.xlsx

Make a 7-slide PowerPoint that teaches fractions to 4th graders: what a fraction is, numerator and denominator, pizza example, equal fractions, comparing fractions, a 3-question quiz, and answers. Short bullets and speaker notes on each slide. Save it as {dir}\fractions-lesson.pptx

Write a Python script with only the standard library that estimates the air conditioner size for a house: rooms are listed at the top (name, square feet, sunny true or false), each room needs 20 BTU per square foot plus 10 percent if sunny, print a line per room and the total, then round the total up to the next half ton (12000 BTU per ton) and print it on the last line as TONS=<number>. Save it as {dir}\ac_size.py

Make a wedding guest list as a CSV file with columns name, side (bride or groom), table, meal (chicken, fish or vegetarian), rsvp (yes, no or waiting), plus_one (yes or no). 40 guests across 6 tables. Save it as {dir}\guest-list.csv

Build a one-page website for a 24/7 emergency plumber: a big call-now button with a tel: link, services list with starting prices, service area towns, three short reviews, and a simple quote request form that shows a thank-you message without sending anything. One self-contained HTML file, mobile friendly. Save it as {dir}\plumber.html

Write a SQLite script for an after-school program: tables for kids, guardians, activities and attendance (with foreign keys), sample rows (8 kids, 6 guardians, 4 activities, 20 attendance rows), and a query that lists each kid's attendance count for this month. Save it as {dir}\afterschool.sql

Write a Node.js script with no packages that holds 12 orders (id, customer, total, shipped true or false, days since order) in an array, prints the orders not shipped after 3 days, and prints the count on the last line as LATE=<number>. Save it as {dir}\late-orders.js

Read-only on the source. Save it as {dir}\copy-sermons.ps1

Write an open house checklist in Markdown: a week before, the day before, the morning of, during the open house, and after, with checkboxes, plus a short sign-in sheet template table. Save it as {dir}\open-house-checklist.md
